description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeViewModel class responsible for managing UI state related to various content categories on a home screen in an Android TV application. It includes data structures for representing each category's loading and error states, and methods for loading and reloading category data via a repository. The file references external repositories, APIs, and AndroidX lifecycle components.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Data class representing UI state for a single content rail, including loading status, error message, and list of content items.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class responsible for loading and managing multiple category rails for the home screen, exposing their states via a StateFlow.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Initiates loading of all categories in parallel.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the data for a specific content category.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Internal method to load a given category, updating its UI state accordingly.
